16530.meaning1: observance of the full moon or new moon fast days

examples.text: yam'pi, bhikkhave, tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno daḷhasamādāno ahosi kusalesu dhammesu, avatthitasamādāno kāyasucarite vacīsucarite manosucarite dānasaṃvibhāge sīlasamādāne uposath'upavāse matteyyatāya petteyyatāya sāmaññatāya brahmaññatāya kule jeṭṭh'āpacāyitāya aññatar'aññataresu ca adhikusalesu dhammesu.

16531.meaning2: observance of the duties of the uposatha day

16532.commentary: (SNa) okilinīvatthusmiṃ uppakkaṃ okiliniṃ okirinin'ti sā kira aṅgāracitake nipannā vipphandamānā viparivattamānā paccati, tasmā uppakkā c'eva hoti uṇhena agginā pakkasarīrā, okilinī ca kilinnasarīrā, bindūni'ssā sarīrato paggharanti, okirinī ca aṅgārasamparikiṇṇā. tassā hi heṭṭhato'pi kiṃsukapupphavaṇṇā aṅgārā, ubhayapassesu'pi, ākāsato'pi'ssā upari patanti. tena vuttaṃ, uppakkaṃ okiliniṃ okirinin'ti.

examples.text: idh'āhaṃ, āvuso, gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ itthiṃ uppakkaṃ okiliniṃ okiriniṃ vehāsaṃ gacchantiṃ. sā sudaṃ aṭṭassaraṃ karoti … esā, bhikkhave, itthī kaliṅgassa rañño aggamah'esī ahosi.

16533.commentary: (SNa) uppaccāpī'ti uppatitvā'pi. sace'pi sakuṇo viya uppatitvā palāyasi, tathā'pi te mokkho n'atthī'ti vadati. evañ'ca pana vatvā sāmaṇeraṃ muñci. sāmaṇero akkhīni ummīlesi, mātā kese pakiriya assasantī passasantī rodati. (THIa) niray'ādīsu catūsu apāyesu manussesu ca tassa phalabhūtaṃ dukkhaṃ ito etto vā palāyante mayi n'ānubandhissatī'ti adhippāyena upecca sañcicca palāyato'pi te tato pāpato mutti mokkhā n'atthi, gatikāl'ādi-paccay'antara-samavāye sati vipaccate evā'ti attho. uppaccā'ti vā pāṭho, uppatitvā'ti attho.

examples.text: na te dukkhā pamuty'atthi, uppaccā'pi palāyato, sace bhāyasi dukkhassa, sace te dukkham'appiyaṃ.
savanti sabbadhi sotā, latā uppajja tiṭṭhati, tañ'ca disvā lataṃ jātaṃ, mūlaṃ paññāya chindatha.

16535.meaning1: appears; arises; occurs; takes place (for or in)
16535.synonym: upapajjati, kamati, niccharati, nibbattati, pabhavati, pavattati, vattati, sañjāyati, samudayati, samudeti, sambhavati, sambhuṇāti

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, saradasamaye thullaphusitake deve vassante udake udakabubbuḷaṃ uppajjati c'eva nirujjhati ca.
tassa attano ca tāsañ'ca devatānaṃ saddhañ'ca sīlañ'ca sutañ'ca cāgañ'ca paññañ'ca anussarato cittaṃ pasīdati, pāmojjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti
gabbham'eke uppajjanti, nirayaṃ pāpakammino, saggaṃ sugatino yanti, parinibbanti anāsavā.

16537.commentary: (VIN 1.4.1.3) uppajjeyyā'ti uppajjeyya saṅghato vā gaṇato vā ñātito vā mittato vā paṃsukūlaṃ vā attano vā dhanena.

examples.text: niṭṭhitacīvarasmiṃ bhikkhunā ubbhatasmiṃ kathine bhikkhuno pan'eva akālacīvaraṃ uppajjeyya, ākaṅkhamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbaṃ, paṭiggahetvā khippam'eva kāretabbaṃ
bhikkhuno pan'eva addhānamaggappaṭipannassa eḷakalomāni uppajjeyyuṃ, ākaṅkhamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbāni, paṭiggahetvā tiyojanaparamaṃ sahatthā haritabbāni asante hārake.

16541.construction:
ud + pajja + ana + ka
uppajjana + ka

examples.text: diṭṭhirāgo'ti pan'ettha dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhiyo nissāya uppajjanakarāgo veditabbo.

16544.meaning1: arising delight; heartfelt joy which appears

16549.commentary: (ANa) uppajjamāno uppajjatī'ti idaṃ pana ubhayam'pi vippakatavacanam'eva. uppajjamāno bahujanahitāya uppajjati, na aññena kāraṇenā'ti evaṃ pan'ettha attho veditabbo. evarūpañ'c'ettha lakkhaṇaṃ na sakkā etaṃ aññena saddalakkhaṇena paṭibāhituṃ.

examples.text: dukkham'eva uppajjamānaṃ uppajjati, dukkhaṃ nirujjhamānaṃ nirujjhatī'ti na kaṅkhati na vicikicchati aparapaccayā ñāṇam'ev'assa ettha hoti. ettāvatā kho, kaccāna, sammādiṭṭhi hoti.
sā kho pan'esā, bhikkhave, taṇhā kattha uppajjamānā uppajjati, kattha nivisamānā nivisati

16550.meaning1: appeared; arose; was born; took place

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, evarūpena javena samannāgatassa evarūpena ca padavītihārena evarūpaṃ icchāgataṃ uppajji, ahaṃ gamanena lokassa antaṃ pāpuṇissāmī'ti.
evaṃ byākaramāno kho, āvuso, rājā pasenadi kosalo sammā byākaramāno byākareyya, idha me sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasantassa sākete kiñci'd'eva accāyikaṃ karaṇīyaṃ uppajji.

16551.meaning2: fit to be born or arisen

16552.meaning1: wanting rebirth; wishing to be reborn

examples.text: atha kho māro pāpimā yena upacālā bhikkhunī ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā upacālaṃ bhikkhuniṃ etadavoca, kattha nu tvaṃ, bhikkhuni, uppajjitu'kāmā'ti? na khv'āhaṃ, āvuso, katthaci uppajjitu'kāmā'ti.

16553.meaning1: to arise; to appear; to come into being

examples.text: n'āhaṃ taṃ pamāṇaṃ atikkamitvā rajjan'ādi-vasena uppajjituṃ dassāmī'ti evam'ettha attho daṭṭhabbo.
na tvaṃ bāle pajānāsi, yathā arahataṃ vaco, aniccā sabbasaṅkhārā, uppādavayadhammino, uppajjitvā nirujjhanti, tesaṃ vūpasamo sukho'ti.

16555.meaning2: is brought into being, is produced; is made available

16557.meaning1: would have arisen; could have occurred (for)
16557.meaning2: would have arisen; would have occurred

examples.text: upahat'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā. sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā pitaraṃ dhammikaṃ dhammarājānaṃ jīvitā na voropessatha, imasmiññ'eva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ uppajjissathā'ti. idam'avoca bhagavā.

16558.meaning1: would become available (for); would accrue (to); could crop up (for)
16558.commentary: (VIN) uppajjeyyā'ti uppajjeyya saṅghato vā gaṇato vā ñātito vā mittato vā paṃsukūlaṃ vā attano vā dhanena.

examples.text: das'āh'ānāgataṃ kattika-temāsika-puṇṇamaṃ, bhikkhuno pan'eva accekacīvaraṃ uppajjeyya
idha, bhante, koci'd'eva dhammo samuppādo uppajjeyya, ekato assa bhagavā ekato bhikkhusaṅgho ca.
sutt'ant'aṭṭhakathāsu pana uppaṭipāṭiyā āgataṃ.

16561.construction:
ud + pati + √paṭ > pāṭ + *i + ka
uppaṭipāṭi + ka

examples.text: suddhikañ'ca soto arahā, duve samaṇabrāhmaṇā, vibhaṅgena tayo vuttā, kaṭṭho uppaṭipāṭikan'ti.

16562.meaning2: out of its order, out of place in succession

16566.grammar: prp of pass of ud √paṇḍ, pass, intrans (+instr)
16566.meaning1: being teased; being mocked; being ridiculed (by)

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ araññagataṃ vā rukkhamūlagataṃ vā suññāgāragataṃ vā mātugāmo upasaṅkamitvā ūhasati ullapati ujjagghati uppaṇḍeti. so mātugāmena ūhasiyamāno ullapiyamāno ujjagghiyamāno uppaṇḍiyamāno saṃsīdati visīdati, na santhambhati, na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ sandhāretuṃ.

16567.grammar: prp of pass of ud √paṇḍ, pass, intrans (+instr)
16567.meaning1: being teased; being mocked; being ridiculed (by)

examples.text: so'haṃ tattha passāmi eke samaṇabrāhmaṇe kise lūkhe dubbaṇṇe uppaṇḍ'uppaṇḍukajāte dhamanisanthatagatte, na viya maññe cakkhuṃ bandhante janassa dassanāya.

16570.meaning1: extremely pale; very pallid; sickly in colour

examples.text: puna capar'āhaṃ, bhante, ārāmena ārāmaṃ, uyyānena uyyānaṃ anucaṅkamāmi anuvicarāmi. so'haṃ tattha passāmi eke samaṇabrāhmaṇe kise lūkhe dubbaṇṇe uppaṇḍ'uppaṇḍukajāte dhamanisanthatagatte, na viya maññe cakkhuṃ bandhante janassa dassanāya.

16571.commentary: (VINa) uppaṇḍentī'ti paṇḍako ayaṃ, n'āyaṃ puriso'ti-ādinā nayena parihāsaṃ karonti. (ANa) uppaṇḍetī'ti uppaṇḍanakathaṃ katheti.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ araññagataṃ vā rukkhamūlagataṃ vā suññāgāragataṃ vā mātugāmo upasaṅkamitvā ūhasati ullapati ujjagghati uppaṇḍeti. so mātugāmena ūhasiyamāno ullapiyamāno ujjagghiyamāno uppaṇḍiyamāno saṃsīdati visīdati, na santhambhati, na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ sandhāretuṃ.

atha kho bhagavā, so maṃ khv'āyaṃ moghapuriso uppaṇḍetī'ti, tato'va paṭinivattitvā, etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā, bhikkhū paṭipucchi, atthi kira, bhikkhave, amukasmiṃ vihāre bhikkhu gilāno'ti? atthi bhagavā'ti.
seyyathā'pi, anuruddhā, puriso vaṭṭakaṃ sithilaṃ gaṇheyya, so tassa hatthato uppateyya, evam'eva kho me, anuruddhā, atilīnavīriyaṃ udapādi, atilīnavīriy'ādhikaraṇañ'ca pana me samādhi cavi.

16574.meaning1: jumps up; springs up; leaps up (towards)

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, anuruddhā, puriso addhānamaggappaṭipanno, tassa ubhatopasse vadhakā uppateyyuṃ, tassa tatonidānaṃ chambhitattaṃ uppajjeyya, evam'eva kho me, anuruddhā, chambhitattaṃ udapādi, chambhitatt'ādhikaraṇañ'ca pana me samādhi cavi. samādhimhi cute obhāso antaradhāyati dassanañ'ca rūpānaṃ.

16576.commentary: (SNa) bījan'ti uppatantānaṃ sattavidhaṃ dhaññabījaṃ seṭṭhaṃ. tasmiñ'hi uggate janapado khemo hoti subhikkho. (SNt) uppatantānan'ti pathaviṃ bhinditvā uṭṭhahantānaṃ.

examples.text: kiṃsu uppatataṃ seṭṭhaṃ, kiṃsu nipatataṃ varaṃ, kiṃsu pavajamānānaṃ, kiṃsu pavadataṃ varan'ti.
bījaṃ uppatataṃ seṭṭhaṃ, vuṭṭhi nipatataṃ varā, gāvo pavajamānānaṃ, putto pavadataṃ varo'ti.

16579.meaning1: sprung up; jumped up; flared up

examples.text: yo ve uppatitaṃ kodhaṃ, rathaṃ bhantaṃ'va vāraye, tam'ahaṃ sārathiṃ brūmi, rasmiggāho itaro jano.
yo uppatitaṃ vineti kodhaṃ, visaṭaṃ sappavisaṃ'va osadhehi, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.
niccaṃ utrastam'idaṃ cittaṃ, niccaṃ ubbiggam'idaṃ mano, anuppannesu kicchesu, atho uppatitesu ca, sace atthi anutrastaṃ, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito'ti.
yo ve uppatitaṃ kodhaṃ, rathaṃ bhantaṃ'va vāraye, tam'ahaṃ sārathiṃ brūmi, rasmiggāho itaro jano.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, divasaṃsantatte ayokapāle haññamāne papaṭikā nibbattitvā uppatitvā nibbāyeyya.
adhipātakā vuccanti sabbā'pi makkhikāyo. kiṃkāraṇā adhipātakā vuccanti sabbā'pi makkhikāyo? tā uppatitvā uppatitvā khādanti, taṃkāraṇā adhipātakā vuccanti sabbā'pi makkhikāyo.
cakkaratanassa hi uppattisamanantaram'eva n'atthi so satto nāma, yo paccatthikasaññāya taṃ rājānaṃ ārabbha āvudhaṃ ukkhipituṃ visaheyya
asaṃvutaṃ hutvā osaramānaṃ kiles'uppattiyā kāraṇabhāvena sadosagamanena gacchatī'ti samuddan'aṭṭhena'pi samuddo.

vivaṭan'ti taṇhāchadanaṃ diṭṭhichadanaṃ kilesachadanaṃ duccaritachadanaṃ avijjāchadanaṃ. tāni chadanāni vivaṭāni honti viddhaṃsitāni ugghāṭitāni samugghāṭitāni pahīnāni samucchinnāni vūpasantāni paṭipassaddhāni abhabb'uppattikāni ñāṇ'agginā daḍḍhāni.

16588.construction:
uppatti + karaṇa + vasa + ena
uppattikaraṇavasa + ena

examples.text: jātisaṃsāro'ti-ādīsu jāyanavasena c'eva saṃsaraṇavasena ca evaṃ laddhanāmānaṃ punabbhavakhandhānaṃ paccayo kamm'ābhisaṅkhāro. so hi punappunaṃ uppattikaraṇavasena parikkhipitvā ṭhitattā parikkhā'ti vuccati, ten'esa tassā saṃkiṇṇattā vikiṇṇattā saṃkiṇṇaparikkho'ti vutto. taṇhā'ti vaṭṭamūlikā taṇhā.
na uppathena gacchanto pathena gacchantassa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
na uppathena gacchantena pathena gacchantassa agilānassa dhammo desetabbo. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca uppathena gacchanto pathena gacchantassa agilānassa dhammaṃ deseti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

16592.meaning1: wrong way; bad road; off course

examples.text: kiṃsu uppatho akkhāto, kiṃsu rattin'divakkhayo, kiṃ malaṃ brahmacariyassa, kiṃ sinānam'anodakan'ti.
rūpaṃ jīrati maccānaṃ, nāmagottaṃ na jīrati, rāgo uppatho'ti vuccati, lobho dhammānaṃ paripantho, vayo rattin'divakkhayo.

16593.meaning1: straying off track; going off course

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ, candaggāho bhavissati, sūriyaggāho bhavissati, nakkhattaggāho bhavissati, candimasūriyānaṃ pathagamanaṃ bhavissati, candimasūriyānaṃ uppathagamanaṃ bhavissati

16595.meaningLit: rule about (teaching the Dhamma to someone while) walking off the path

examples.text: tass'idaṃ, bhikkhave, manussattaṃ laddhaṃ, tathāgato loke uppanno arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, tathāgatappavedito ca dhammavinayo loke dibbati.
tañ'ca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, yatth'assa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
āyantu bhonto ye tattha khattiyakulā brāhmaṇakulā rājaññakulā uppannā, sākassa vā sālassa vā salaḷassa vā candanassa vā padumakassa vā uttar'āraṇiṃ ādāya aggiṃ abhinibbattentu, tejo pātukarontu.

16599.meaning1: fact of having arisen; fact of having appeared

examples.text: micchādiṭṭhī'ti adevalokagāmimaggam'eva devalokagāmimaggo'ti gahetvā uppannatāya sā assa micchādiṭṭhi nāma hoti. aññataraṃ gatiṃ vadāmī'ti tassa hi nirayato vā tiracchānayonito vā aññā gati n'atthi, tasmā evam'āha.
evam'pi asamudācāravasena anuppanno uppajjati nāma. evaṃ tāva asamudācāravasena anuppannassa uppannatā veditabbā.
